alternate_names: Shri Ram Janki Mandir, Kagzi Muhalla

history.period: Modern local temple; founding date undocumented
history.summary: Generic CSV name ('Ram Janki Mandir, Siwan') has no single documented referent: Siwan district has several (Kagzi Muhalla, Chhitauli Bazar/Laxmiganj, Madhopur, Surwal/Zeradei, Bhaisakhal, Goraiya Kothi). This file documents the in-town Kagzi Muhalla shrine (Yappe 5.0; 0.38 km from Siwan Kacher railway station). No published history, dynasty, or founder exists for it. Disambiguation note: a separate Shri Ram Janki Mandir at Goraiya Kothi, Siwan district, is a registered religious trust under the Bihar State Board of Religious Trusts (subject of Patna High Court judgment CWJC 15159/2019, decided 4 Feb 2020) — a different institution, not this one. Identity ambiguous — flag before publishing. Coordinates are Siwan town-level approximations, not the temple POI.

name: Ram Janki Mandir (Kagzi Muhalla)
town_description: Siwan is a city and district headquarters in northwestern Bihar on the Saran–Gopalganj corridor, with a busy junction (Siwan Junction) on the Chhapra–Gorakhpur rail line. Nearby attractions include the Mahendranath Shiva temple at Mehdar and the Dakshina Kali shrine at Darauli.
